name: grimmsnarl_ml_v4_5
code_change_note: deck.csv, fallback_policy.py, main.py, ml_features.py, ml_planner.py, ml_runtime.py, and policy_base.py are byte-identical to v4. Only ranker_model.json and metadata.json differ.
teacher_selection_note: The refreshed model improves both the new rank-3 team and the existing pin. The existing pin is retained because pin 16422241 tied it 20-20 in the v5-controlled pin experiment.

model.kind: LightGBM lambdarank distilled to standard-library tree JSON

versus_v4_smoke.note: A safety smoke test, not a precise strength estimate.

policy: Exactly the v4 fallback policy and one-ply planner, with only the team-conditioned imitation ranker refreshed to the selected 2000-tree model. No v5 search-budget or planner changes are included.
validation_scope: The model was pairwise-evaluated against ranker_v4 on refreshed and frozen chronological test blocks, checked separately on the new rank-3 team and existing pin, passed all 116 copied v4 tests, and completed 20 alternating-seat local games against v4 without crashes or illegal selections. Ladder rating is not measured.
description: v4.5 isolates the effect of the August 2026 data refresh. It is a byte-for-byte copy of v4 outside the ranker and metadata, using the promoted 2000-tree model trained from 4,097 newest-balanced same-deck games.
